title: QA Engineer
description:
**Automation Tester / QA Engineer**

**Company**: Descrptive Solution Private Limited

**Location**: 2nd Floor, A\-62, Block A, Okhla Phase II, Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi,

Delhi – 110020

**Employment Type**: Full\-Time

**Experience**: 0–2 Year

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and proactive Automation Tester / QA Engineer to

support automated and manual testing of web and mobile applications. The role involves

creating and executing automated test scripts, identifying and reporting defects, and

working closely with developers to ensure product quality. This is a great opportunity to

build strong skills and a career in QA Automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts for web and/or mobile applications under appropriate guidance.
* Perform manual and automated testing to identify functional and technical issues.
* Create and execute test cases based on product requirements and specifications.
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and usability testing.
* Identify, document, and track software defects using tools such as Jira or Bugzilla.
* Retest resolved defects and performed regression testing to ensure issues have been properly fixed.
* Support the development and maintenance of automation frameworks using tool such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or Appium.
* Write and maintain clean, reusable, and well\-organized automation scripts.
* Analyze automated test results and report failures or unexpected behavior.
* Collaborate with developers and product teams to understand requirements and ensure quality standards.
* Maintain test cases, automation scripts, test data, documentation, and test reports.
* Participate in test planning and contribute ideas to improve test coverage and automation efficiency.
* Assist in identifying repetitive manual test scenarios that can be automated.

**Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Basic understanding of manual and automation testing concepts.
* Fundamental knowledge of at least one automation tool/framework such as:

o Selenium WebDriver

o Cypress

o Playwright

o Appium

* Basic programming/scripting knowledge in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
* Understanding of locators, XPath/CSS selectors, assertions, waits, and basic test execution.
* Ability to write and execute test cases based on requirements.
* Basic knowledge of defect reporting and tracking tools such as Jira or Bugzilla.
* Understanding of functional, regression, smoke, and sanity testing.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

**Good to Have**

* Basic knowledge of SQL and database testing.
* Familiarity with API testing and tools such as Postman.
* Basic understanding of Git/GitHub or other version control systems.
* Familiarity with automation testing frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, or similar.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools such as Jenkins.
* Exposure to web or mobile application testing projects.
* Relevant QA/testing certifications.
* Academic, internship, or personal projects involving test automation.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on real\-world web/mobile applications.
* Hands\-on exposure to automation testing frameworks and tools.
* Learning and growth opportunities in QA and Test Automation.
* Collaborative and supportive work environment.
* Opportunity to develop skills in automation, API testing, databases, Git, and CI/CD.

Pay: ₹200,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Quality Assurance Lead – Automation
description:
**QA Lead – Automation**
========================

**Experience:** 5\+ Years**Location:** Gurugram**About Fairdeal.Market**
-------------------------


Fairdeal.Market is a fast\-growing B2B quick\-commerce platform transforming how retailers, wholesalers, and manufacturers buy and sell everyday products.
We are building a technology\-driven supply chain that combines commerce, logistics, dark stores, data, and automation to deliver a seamless buying experience for retailers.
As we scale rapidly, we are looking for a **QA Lead – Automation** who can take ownership of our quality engineering function and build scalable, reliable, and efficient automation practices across our products.**Role Overview**
-----------------


As the **QA Lead – Automation**, you will be responsible for driving the overall QA strategy with a strong focus on automation, framework development, test coverage, and release quality.
You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and Business teams to ensure that our applications, APIs, integrations, and critical business workflows are thoroughly tested and production\-ready.
This is a **hands\-on leadership role** where you will be expected to design automation frameworks, write and review automation scripts, improve QA processes, mentor team members, and establish quality standards across the engineering organization.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Automation \& Framework Development**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for web and mobile applications.
* Develop automated test cases for critical business workflows and regression suites.
* Identify manual test cases that can be effectively automated.
* Improve automation coverage, execution speed, reliability, and maintainability.
* Conduct code reviews for automation scripts and ensure adherence to coding standards.
* Evaluate and introduce new automation tools and technologies where required.

### **API \& Backend Testing**

* Build and maintain API automation suites.
* Test REST APIs, integrations, backend services, and data flows.
* Validate API responses, business logic, error handling, authentication, and integrations.
* Work closely with backend engineers to identify and resolve quality issues.

### **CI/CD \& Quality Engineering**

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Work with engineering teams to establish automated quality gates.
* Monitor automation failures and improve test stability.
* Contribute to continuous testing practices across development and deployment cycles.

### **QA Strategy \& Leadership**

* Define and implement the overall QA and automation strategy.
* Own test planning, regression strategy, test coverage, and release quality.
* Establish QA processes, standards, and best practices.
* Define and track QA metrics and automation KPIs.
* Mentor and guide QA engineers and help build a strong quality engineering culture.
* Participate in hiring and evaluation of QA team members.

### **Product \& Release Quality**

* Work closely with Product Managers, Developers, and Engineering Leads to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Identify critical user journeys and ensure adequate test coverage.
* Own QA sign\-off and provide risk\-based recommendations for releases.
* Investigate production issues and drive root\-cause analysis.
* Ensure critical workflows such as catalog, cart, checkout, orders, payments, inventory, pricing, and delivery\-related flows are thoroughly tested.

**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------

* 6–10 years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience in **test automation**.
* Experience designing or building automation frameworks from scratch.
* Strong experience with tools such as **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium**, or similar.
* Strong programming/scripting experience in **Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript**.
* Strong understanding of API testing and automation.
* Experience with **Postman, Rest Assured**, or equivalent API testing tools.
* Experience integrating automated testing with **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Working knowledge of **Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar tools**.
* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test planning, regression testing, and defect management.
* Experience with Git/version control systems.
* Experience mentoring or leading QA engineers.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience in **e\-commerce, B2B commerce, quick\-commerce, logistics, fintech, or marketplace products**.
* Experience testing high\-volume transactional systems.
* Experience with mobile application testing.
* Knowledge of performance/load testing tools such as JMeter or similar.
* Experience working with cloud environments.
* Basic understanding of SQL and database testing.
* Experience working in fast\-paced startup environments.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

  

* Thinks beyond test cases and focuses on **overall product quality**.
* Is hands\-on with automation and can independently solve complex testing challenges.
* Can build automation frameworks rather than simply execute existing scripts.
* Takes ownership of quality from development to production.
* Can balance speed, quality, and business priorities.
* Has strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Enjoys working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth startup environment.

**Why Join Fairdeal.Market?**
-----------------------------

* Opportunity to work on a rapidly scaling B2B quick\-commerce platform.
* Build and own QA automation practices from the ground up.
* Work closely with Engineering and Product leadership.
* Solve real\-world problems across commerce, logistics, inventory, and technology.
* High ownership and significant impact on the product and engineering culture.

title: Calypso QA Analyst / Calypso Test Engineer
description:
##### **Project description**

Work on quality assurance and testing of the Calypso trading platform (v16\+) across Rates, Credit, Fixed Income, Derivatives, and Backoffice. The role involves end\-to\-end functional, regression, UAT, and batch/EOD testing covering trade lifecycle, pricing, market data, settlements, accounting, reporting, and reconciliation. The position will collaborate with BA, development, environment, and operations teams throughout release cycles.


##### **Responsibilities**


Design, execute, and maintain functional, regression, and UAT test cases for Calypso.


Test trade capture, pricing, lifecycle events, settlements, confirmations, accounting, and backoffice processing.


Validate EOD and scheduled batch processing, including scheduled tasks, engines, jobs, logs, and task status.


Test market data setup and consumption, including curves, quotes, feeds, and valuation inputs, and validate their impact on pricing, P\&L, and reports.


Test Fixed Income products such as bonds and repos, including related reporting and reconciliation flows.


Test Rates/Credit Derivatives covering trade lifecycle and valuations.


Perform trade, position, cash, and report reconciliation between Calypso and downstream/related systems.


Analyse release\-to\-release and environment\-to\-environment differences across trades, reports, extracts, CSV/XML files, and other outputs.


Raise clear, evidence\-based defects and support defect triage through closure.


Execute and monitor Jenkins jobs for regression packs, batch runs, test environments, and file comparisons.


Use SQL to validate trade attributes, static data, market data, and post\-batch results.


Use Linux for log analysis, file handling, job monitoring, and basic environment troubleshooting.


Support test planning, change\-request coverage, regression execution, and test summary/sign\-off activities.


Work closely with BA, development, environment, and operations teams during releases.


##### **Skills**


Must have


4–12 years of overall experience in software testing/QA.


Mandatory hands\-on Calypso testing experience on Calypso v16 or higher.


Strong understanding of Calypso trade lifecycle, static data, and relevant Calypso modules.


Hands\-on experience with Calypso EOD/batch processing and scheduled tasks/jobs.


Experience in functional and regression testing of trading/markets applications.


Strong understanding of at least relevant areas across Fixed Income, Rates/Credit Derivatives, and Backoffice.


Experience validating trade, position, cash, reports, extracts, and reconciliation results.


Ability to analyse test failures and reconciliation breaks and identify business/technical root causes.


Strong test\-case design, execution, defect management, and release testing experience.


Ability to work effectively within tight, release\-driven regression cycles.


Nice to have


SQL for trade, position, market data, and batch\-result validation.


Linux/Unix skills for logs, files, processes, and job troubleshooting.


Jenkins experience for CI/CD, regression, and batch job execution/monitoring.


Market data knowledge covering curves, FX, bonds, credit spreads, and feeds.


Domain knowledge of Fixed Income, Derivatives, Backoffice, pricing, P\&L, CSA/collateral, and trade reconciliation.


Experience with regression comparison tools, CSV/file\-diff utilities, or Calypso QA automation.


Exposure to related platforms/interfaces such as Murex, MarkitWire, Bloomberg, or schedulers such as Control\-M.


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or equivalent practical experience.
